annotation.interpretation_a: The client can only send one complete HTTP request (including headers and body) on a given QUIC stream during the entire connection.
annotation.interpretation_b: The client can only send one HTTP request at a time on a given QUIC stream; it can send subsequent requests on the same stream after completing the previous one.
annotation.justification: The term 'request' is not clearly defined. It could refer to the entire request-response exchange, or just the initial request message. This leads to two reasonable interpretations of the clause.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'request' is not precise. Does it refer to a complete request-response cycle, or simply the initial sending of the request headers?
